block.business_records.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.business_records.model.title: Business Records
block.business_records.model.description: Look up local reference data and apply exact, revision-checked updates only after explicit approval.
block.business_records.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.business_records.help_namespace: Local data partition owned by this node. Use a new namespace for a different seed dataset.
block.business_records.help_object_types: Allowed object types, such as inventory or orders. No external ERP is contacted.
block.business_records.help_field_mappin: Canonical output field → source field. Flat exact keys only; source IDs are never editable.
block.business_records.help_match_fields: Canonical fields accepted by exact reference matching. Multiple matches remain visible.
block.business_records.help_allow_writes: Allow explicitly approved changes to this node’s local dataset only. Off by default.
block.business_records.help_writable_fie: Canonical fields that may be proposed for updates. Keep empty for read-only operation.
block.business_records.help_seed_data: Initial array of {object_type, source_id, data}. Imported once on first request; never overwrites edited records. No secrets.
block.business_records.help_proposal_ttl: Validity of an exact update proposal in seconds. Expiry never triggers a change.
block.business_records.help_max_records: Maximum seed records per partition. There is no implicit ERP synchronization.
block.business_records.help_max_proposal: Retained proposals per partition. Replay protection is never silently pruned; full storage refuses new proposals.
block.business_records.help_max_bytes: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per request or normalized record. Total seed size is separately limited to 4 MiB.
